description: This file manages session override logic for authentication profiles, including loading session store runtime, validating profiles, clearing overrides, and resolving profile overrides based on session state and cooldowns.

methods.name: loadSessionStoreRuntime
methods.description: Lazily loads the session store runtime module and caches the promise.

methods.name: isProfileForProvider
methods.description: Checks if a given profile belongs to a specified provider.

methods.name: clearSessionAuthProfileOverride
methods.description: Removes override information from a session entry and updates the session store.

methods.name: resolveSessionAuthProfileOverride
methods.description: Determines and sets the appropriate auth profile override for a session based on various conditions.
